organizations.name: LULAC - #380
organizations.description: As a member of the LULAC council at Loras College, I work together with other members to be the voice of the Latinx population of the school. We educate others on different Latinx cultures, bring light to issues facing our community and most importantly, we work to provide resources and a safe space on campus for students of all communities.
